task: P02-T3 NASP Head opcode, NASP client adapter and native offline/resume stages across a NAS cold restart
summary: 43/100 unchanged. NASP gains read-only opcode 15 Head; native-client gains a Remote trait with a NASP adapter that maps a sent Commit without a valid reply to Unknown. The native NAS gate adds an offline stage (the guest commits revision 1 over NASP, the NAS exits, the next edit cannot deliver Open and stays NeedsReconcile) and a resume stage on the same disk (recovery, a base-0 edit reconciles to Conflict, the offline edit reconciles via Head to Ready and commits revision 2). Both pass with raw QEMU exit 33 and the disk oracle. P02 stays open: no client persistence, in-boot NAS restart, late-reply drop, real transport, identity or power loss.
